title: See i crafted
body: You can now craft blocks and items that couldn't be crafted before. If you don't want to search for the Death Totem, you can craft it right away. Don't want a torch in your house? Make a light block to create an invisible light source. This mod is still in development! Download it to take your survival world to another level. There's no need to download individual mods as they're all included in one mod. (The file and mod name are different and incorrect, so don't use the file name.) plase use jei  https://modrinth.com/mod/jei/versions
